c74object.name: evi_pan_dual
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Pan audio signals, dual
c74object.description:
evi_pan_dual is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_pan_dual.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_utilities.genexpr
Pan inputs to outputs using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'. evi_pan_dual is available in MSP as evi.pan~ @mode 1

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ left, right, panning1, panning2 } }

geninlet.name: left
geninlet.digest: Input. Left audio input to be panned

geninlet.name: right
geninlet.digest: Input. Right audio input to be panned

geninlet.name: panning1
geninlet.digest: 0..1 @min 0 @max 1 @default 0.. Pan 1 Amount 0..1, Pan input to outputs using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'.

geninlet.name: panning2
geninlet.digest: 0..1 @min 0 @max 1 @default 1.. Pan 2 Amount 0..1, Pan input to outputs using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'.
